research.title: Conformal Prediction Under Heteroskedastic Noise
bullets: Designed experiments comparing split conformal and residual normalized prediction intervals across simulated regression settings with input dependent noise.
Analyzed marginal coverage, subgroup coverage, and interval width to characterize sensitivity to calibration sample composition and variance estimation errors.

research.title: Probability Calibration with Missing Predictors
bullets: Designed comparisons of logistic regression and tree ensembles under controlled missingness mechanisms, evaluating imputation choices and post hoc probability calibration.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, Brier score decompositions, and subgroup calibration across repeated splits to distinguish discrimination changes from probability estimation errors.

publications.title: Post Hoc Calibration Under Changing Predictor Missingness: An Empirical Study
Imputation Choices and Probability Reliability in Tabular Classification

work.title: Data Import Validation and Error Handling
bullets: Implemented validation checks for tabular data imports, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and duplicate records within an existing processing service.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and revised error messages to support issue diagnosis during routine maintenance and code review.

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression workflows with standardized predictors and nested cross validation for selecting regularization strengths without evaluation leakage.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability across correlated feature settings, examining how redundant predictors affected variable selection and shrinkage behavior.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Models for Overlapping Clusters
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization for Gaussian mixture models with diagonal and full covariance structures, including convergence checks and multiple initialization strategies.
Compared clustering assignments and held out log likelihood against k means baselines across synthetic datasets with varying overlap and anisotropy.

projects.title: Predictive Uncertainty in Neural Network Regression
bullets: Implemented dropout sampling and independently initialized neural network ensembles for regression using shared architectures, training splits, and preprocessing procedures.
Compared predictive error and uncertainty estimates on interpolation and extrapolation regions, examining sensitivity to model capacity and training sample composition.

projects.title: Bootstrap Confidence Intervals for Skewed Data
bullets: Implemented percentile, basic, and bias corrected bootstrap intervals for estimating population means under skewed distributions and contaminated sampling conditions.
Compared empirical coverage and interval length in repeated simulations, documenting sensitivity to sample size, tail behavior, and bootstrap resampling variability.
